prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred channels. I can help you find the best fit. Quick questions first:

- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce sales, app installs, SEO, content, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget for agency work?
- Company size / stage? (startup, SMB, enterprise)
- Any channel priorities? (paid search/social, SEO, email, CRO, content, creative/video)
- Do you need an SF‑based in‑person team or is remote OK?

How to choose an agency (fast checklist)
- Relevant experience: case studies in your industry and channel.
- Measurable results: KPIs, ROI examples, before/after metrics.
- Team expertise: specialists (PPC, SEO, creative) or jack‑of‑all.
- Transparency: reporting cadence, access to accounts, pricing model.
- Process & tools: onboarding, communication, A/B testing cadence.
- Culture fit & references: talk to current/past clients.
- Trial/project: start with a small paid pilot before committing long term.

Questions to ask agencies in interviews
- Can you show 2–3 case studies with metrics similar to our goals?
- Who will be our day‑to‑day contacts and what are their backgrounds?
- How do you measure success and how often will you report?
- What’s your pricing model (retainer, hourly, performance)?
- What would you do in the first 30/90/180 days?

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll:
- Recommend 4–6 San Francisco agencies tailored to your needs (including boutique growth shops vs. full‑service firms),
- Suggest a short RFP and interview template,
- And propose a pilot project scope to evaluate fit.

Which option would you like?
